sentences.en: The team won the semifinals and advanced to the finals.
sentences.zh: 1. 队伍赢得了半决赛，并晋级到了决赛。

sentences.en: The idea was so advanced that I couldn't understand it.
sentences.zh: 2. 这个想法太先进了，我都无法理解。

sentences.en: Our company needs someone who is at home in advanced technology.
sentences.zh: 3. 我们公司需要一个对先进技术驾轻就熟的人才。

senses.zh: 先进的；高级的；晚期的；年老的
前进；增加；上涨（advance的过去式和过去分词形式）
